## Predictive & Corrective Maintenance Rules - Production Line A

Document: SOP-003 | Rev: 1.5 | Date: 2025-09-01 |

Author: Ing. A. Conti - Maintenance Engineering

## 1. Predictive Maintenance Rules

| Rule ID   | Sensor   | Station               | Trigger                                                                   | Action                                                                    | Priority                                                                  |
|-----------|----------|-----------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| MAINT-01  | VIB      | ST04_PACKAGING        | VIB DRIFT >0.05 mm/s over 60 min Inspect and lubricate bearing HIGH       | VIB DRIFT >0.05 mm/s over 60 min Inspect and lubricate bearing HIGH       | VIB DRIFT >0.05 mm/s over 60 min Inspect and lubricate bearing HIGH       |
| MAINT-02  | CUR      | ST02_SEALING          | CUR DRIFT >1.0 A for 30+ min Inspect sealing jaw                          | CUR DRIFT >1.0 A for 30+ min Inspect sealing jaw                          | HIGH                                                                      |
| MAINT-03  | TEN      | ST03_LABELLING        | TEN STUCK >10 samples                                                     | Replace sensor                                                            | MEDIUM                                                                    |
| MAINT-04  | PRS      | ST01_FILLING          | PRS <3.3 bar for >15 min                                                  | Inspect filter and pump                                                   | MEDIUM                                                                    |
| MAINT-05  | TMP      | SRV01_SERVERROOM      | TMP >25°C for >5 min                                                      | Activate secondary cooling                                                | CRITICAL                                                                  |
| MAINT-06  | TMP      | WRH01_WAREHOUSE       | TMP DRIFT >2°C over 2 h                                                   | Inspect compressor; notify                                                | QC CRITICAL                                                               |
| MAINT-07  | TMP      | CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE | TMP >20°C for >10 min                                                     | Emergency ventilation; notify                                             | safety officer CRITICAL                                                   |
| MAINT-08  | HUM      | RND01_RDLAB           | HUM DRIFT >10%RH over 60 min Activate dehumidifier; check HVAC drain HIGH | HUM DRIFT >10%RH over 60 min Activate dehumidifier; check HVAC drain HIGH | HUM DRIFT >10%RH over 60 min Activate dehumidifier; check HVAC drain HIGH |

## 2. Correlated Fault Resolution

| Pattern                                                                                                                                                                         | Primary Fault                                                                                                                                                                   | Secondary Effect                                                                                                                                                                | Resolution                                                                                                                                                                      |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ST02_SEALING-CUR › fi ST04_PACKAGING-SPDfl Sealing motor overload Conveyor speed drop via electrical coupling 1.Verify ST02-CUR trend. 2.Inspect sealing jaw. 3.Reset ST04 spee | ST02_SEALING-CUR › fi ST04_PACKAGING-SPDfl Sealing motor overload Conveyor speed drop via electrical coupling 1.Verify ST02-CUR trend. 2.Inspect sealing jaw. 3.Reset ST04 spee | ST02_SEALING-CUR › fi ST04_PACKAGING-SPDfl Sealing motor overload Conveyor speed drop via electrical coupling 1.Verify ST02-CUR trend. 2.Inspect sealing jaw. 3.Reset ST04 spee | ST02_SEALING-CUR › fi ST04_PACKAGING-SPDfl Sealing motor overload Conveyor speed drop via electrical coupling 1.Verify ST02-CUR trend. 2.Inspect sealing jaw. 3.Reset ST04 spee |
| WRH01-TMP › fi QC HOLD Cold warehouse                                                                                                                                           | drift                                                                                                                                                                           | Product quality risk                                                                                                                                                            | 1.Restore WRH01-TMP <8°C. 2.Notify QC. 3.Place batch on HOLD                                                                                                                    |
